parsed.summary: Router r2 acts as a gateway between the client segment (10.0.1.0/24) and the server segment (10.0.2.0/24), while also providing connectivity to the dmz and sensors segments via r3. It serves as a bridge between internal segments and external routers through dedicated links.

interfaces.name: eth1
interfaces.role: gateway for the client segment via link to r1

interfaces.name: eth4
interfaces.role: gateway for the dmz and sensors segments via link to r3

static_routes.purpose: enable reachability to the client segment through r1
enable reachability to the dmz segment via r3
enable reachability to the sensors segment via r3
